title: Copycats: Weight Tweak
description: Instantly balances copycat block mass with a realistic default configuration for stable Create: Aeronautics/Sable physics. Fully customizable via an in-game menu or JSON configs.
body:
# Copycats Weight Tweaker

Tired of copycat blocks completely throwing off your Create: Aeronautics airship physics? **Copycats Weight Tweaker** gives you full control over the mass properties of your copycat blocks so your assemblies fly exactly the way you designed them.

---

## 🔌 Requirements

* **Catalogue:** This mod requires the **[Catalogue](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/catalogue)** mod installed to access and display the in-game configuration screen.

---

## 🚀 Features

* **Pre-Balanced Out of the Box:** Includes a tuned default configuration that instantly brings copycat blocks down to a reasonable, realistic weight right after installation.
* **Easy Customization:** Modify mass values using a clean, in-game configuration screen powered by Catalogue.
* **Aeronautics Optimized:** Seamlessly registers custom data properties to prevent heavy block calculation glitches on flying structures.

---

## ⚠️ Important Note

> **Physics adjustments do not apply in real-time.** Because of how the data engine registers block properties during world initialization, you must **save and reload your world** (or restart the server) after changing your mass values for the new weights to take effect.
